description: The roadrunner server from frameworks/roadrunner behind stock reverse proxies. Gateway: nginx (h2) or Caddy (h3) terminates TLS on :8443, serves /static/* from disk with precompressed sidecars, and proxies the rest to roadrunner on :8080 over HTTP/1.1 keepalive. Production stack: nginx auth_request against the shared authsvc on every /api/* call; the server does cache-aside in process (ETS, 1 s item TTL, 30 s user TTL) over epgsql and invalidates on writes.
